page-title: Holy Citizen | Discord and Kick Community Tools
page-description: Manage your Discord server and Kick chat more effectively with Holy Citizen. Welcome, support, moderation, and chat tools for streamers and moderators.
hero-proof: Dedicated solutions for Discord and Kick
hero-subtitle: Keep welcomes, support, moderation, and engagement organized across your Discord server and Kick chat with two dedicated tools.
discord-title: Create a more organized server experience.
discord-lead: Welcome new members, manage support requests, and help your moderation team work effectively. The bot supports multiple servers.
feat-welcome: Automatic welcome message for new members
feat-xp: XP and levels that encourage member engagement
feat-moderation: Moderation commands for managing members and messages
feat-antiraid: Alerts when many members join in a short period
feat-lang: Turkish and English replies based on Discord locale
note-discord-invite: Review the permissions needed to add the bot to your server in the setup steps.
kick-lead: Edit welcome messages, commands, points, and phrase filtering in a Turkish-language admin panel.
feat-oauth: Secure connection to your Kick account
feat-commands: Custom commands managed from the admin panel
feat-greeting: One-time greeting on first chat message
feat-filter: Case-insensitive word-based message filtering and deletion
feat-panel: Turkish-language panel for commands, points, and filters
note-kick-panel: The Kick bot needs a server to run its management panel.
commands-title: One command when you need it.
cmd-kick: Kicks a member from the server
cmd-add: Adds a new custom command (via panel)
cmd-block: Filters the specified phrase and deletes the message
start-title: Start with the solution for your platform.
step1-desc: Add the bot to your server and set the permissions your moderation team needs.
step2-desc: Prepare a server for the bot, connect your Kick account, and configure your chat settings.
step3-desc: Configure command responses, point templates, and blocked phrases from the management panel.
faq-a1: Yes, both bots are free to use. The Kick bot also requires a server to run.
faq-a2: Only if you want to use the Kick chat bot. The Discord bot does not require a Kick account.
faq-a3: This site is available in Turkish and English. The Discord bot replies based on user language; the Kick admin panel is in Turkish.
faq-q4: What do I need to use the Kick bot?
faq-a4: You need to connect your Kick account and prepare a server to run the bot.
